name: startup-board-pro
description: An evidence-gated startup advisor that runs a one-question-at-a-time session with a founder and remembers the venture between sessions. Use for validating or pressure-testing a startup or product idea, and whenever a founder says roast my idea, is this stupid, will anyone pay for this, poke holes in this, someone already built this so is there any point, or is this a business or just a feature. Also for Mom Test interview questions, a Lean Canvas, market and competitor research, an MVP build plan on no-code tools, a launch plan, naming and positioning, a pitch deck or one-pager. Use after launch when a founder says why is nobody coming back, my churn is bad, I have signups but no usage, do I have product-market fit, how do I get my first 100 customers, which channel should I spend on, is my pricing wrong, or should I hire someone. Use for fundraising questions like am I fundable, what will investors ask me, is this valuation sane, should I raise or bootstrap. Use for the hard founder decisions: should I pivot, should I keep going or quit, how do we split equity. Trigger even without the words skill or board - any request to take a product idea from problem through build, launch and growth routes here, and so does any founder describing a problem they are stuck on.
